findings.reason: a node scoping §33 through §31's 208 filter inherits the "no refinement/supersession operation" predicate and finds none of the 14, because that predicate removes every name §33 exists to link.
findings.text: §33 counts its 14 as a class of the 208 §31 splits ("§31 to §33 each take one class", plan.html:221), but the 14 it means are the census's `refine_product_successor_compacted` (12) and `spelling_or_rename_supersede` (2) classes, and §31 defines the 208 by "no supersession, retirement or refinement operation in their change log", which excludes exactly those 14 — the 12 carry a `refine`/`backfill_refine` change and the 2 carry a `supersede_legacy_spelling` change (`docs/evidence/fragments/sn-integrity-backlog/sib-superseded-lineage-census.html:104-160`); the arithmetic is 183+25 = 208, so the 208 and the 14 are disjoint and the ruling's 183+25+14 = 222 spans two remedy classes, not one

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — the two named identities resolve, and `supersede_legacy_spelling` resolves as the recorded operation (`imas_codex/standard_names/edit.py:2238`, `docs/evidence/sn-graph-wide-integrity/legacy-spelling-supersede.md`), which names both targets (`minimum_safety_factor`, `toroidal_neutral_internal_state_momentum_diffusion_coefficient`).
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §33 now floors the gate at the 2 legacy spellings (whose targets the recorded supersession fixes) plus every refine product the evidence adjudicates, and its refused control row and the no-write replay are declared negative controls, so the gate is no longer satisfiable by linking nothing.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the authority JSON and the fragment both land in `docs/evidence/fragments/sn-integrity-backlog/`, committed paths beside the §30 census, not a scratchpad or node-local temp.
rubric_items.naming: pass — no plan label, stage name, ticket number or version tag reaches a symbol, comment or code path; the `sib-` fragment ids are artifact names following the sibling-fragment convention.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §33's cohort of 14 is drawn from the census classes that §31's 208 cohort explicitly excludes.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §33 carries one deliverable — the 14 successor-less superseded names.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — the composed surface carries no relationship attributes on s31–s33, and §31 names §32 and §33 as the sections taking the other classes, so the dependency the plan needs is present in prose.
